<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Android status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="17" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">9:41</text>
    <line x1="324" y1="15" x2="324" y2="11" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="15" x2="328" y2="9" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="15" x2="332" y2="7" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="12" r="2.2" fill="#323232"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="15" x2="353" y2="12" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="12" x2="356" y2="15" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="12" x2="353" y2="9" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="9" x2="356" y2="12" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="7" width="18" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="383" y="10" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
    <rect x="367" y="9" width="12" height="6" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="25" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="28,56 20,62 28,68" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="62" x2="37" y2="62" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="52" y="67" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Search flights</text>
    <circle cx="357" cy="59" r="12" fill="#FFF1F3"/>
    <circle cx="357" cy="55" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="351,66 351,63 357,60 363,63 363,66" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="87" x2="390" y2="87" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip mode tabs -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="113" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Round trip</text>
    <text x="128" y="113" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">One way</text>
    <text x="208" y="113" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Multi-city</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="124" x2="91" y2="124" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="126" x2="390" y2="126" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main search card shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="141" width="356" height="277" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="17" y="138" width="356" height="277" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="34" y="163" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">FLIGHT ROUTE</text>

    <!-- origin -->
    <rect x="31" y="176" width="315" height="54" rx="7" fill="#FFF8F9" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="197" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="197" r="2" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="69" y="194" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">FROM</text>
    <text x="69" y="215" font-family="Roboto" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Jakarta</text>
    <text x="285" y="213" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">CGK</text>

    <!-- swap -->
    <circle cx="346" cy="230" r="16" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="226" x2="352" y2="226" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="348,222 352,226 348,230" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="234" x2="340" y2="234" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="344,230 340,234 344,238" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- destination -->
    <rect x="31" y="239" width="315" height="54" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="260" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="260" r="2" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="69" y="257" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">TO</text>
    <text x="69" y="278" font-family="Roboto" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Bali</text>
    <text x="285" y="276" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">DPS</text>

    <!-- dates -->
    <rect x="31" y="304" width="151" height="57" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="44" y="321" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">DEPARTURE</text>
    <text x="44" y="345" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Fri, 18 Jul 2026</text>
    <line x1="166" y1="328" x2="166" y2="346" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="194" y="321" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">RETURN</text>
    <text x="194" y="345" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Sun, 20 Jul</text>
    <rect x="190" y="304" width="156" height="57" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- tiny calendar -->
    <rect x="319" y="317" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="322" x2="333" y2="322" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="314" x2="323" y2="319" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="314" x2="329" y2="319" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- traveler and class -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="449" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Travelers & class</text>
    <rect x="22" y="462" width="346" height="64" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="486" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="482" r="2.7" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <ellipse cx="46" cy="490" rx="5" ry="2.8" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="64" y="486" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">1 passenger</text>
    <text x="64" y="507" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Economy</text>
    <polyline points="343,487 348,492 353,487" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- options row -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="540" width="15" height="15" rx="3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <polyline points="25,547 29,551 35,544" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="46" y="552" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Add nearby airports</text>
    <rect x="211" y="540" width="15" height="15" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="232" y="552" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Direct flights only</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Search button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="573" width="346" height="51" rx="25" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="22" y="570" width="346" height="51" rx="25" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <circle cx="151" cy="595" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="157" y1="601" x2="163" y2="607" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="174" y="601" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Search flights</text>
  </g>

  <!-- promo / information card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="641" width="346" height="70" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
    <rect x="22" y="639" width="346" height="70" rx="10" fill="#FFF1F3"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="674" r="19" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <polygon points="42,677 59,668 55,681 47,684" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="682" x2="44" y2="688" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="80" y="665" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Flexible travel plans?</text>
    <text x="80" y="685" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Search nearby dates to find a better fare.</text>
    <text x="80" y="702" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#DB6186">View fare calendar</text>
    <polyline points="349,698 354,703 349,708" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="765" width="390" height="79" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="765" x2="390" y2="765" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <polygon points="39,786 49,778 59,786 59,799 39,799" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="36,786 49,775 62,786" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="49" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
    <!-- search active -->
    <circle cx="129" cy="787" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="793" x2="141" y2="799" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="129" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Search</text>
    <!-- bookings -->
    <rect x="197" y="779" width="18" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="784" x2="211" y2="784" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="789" x2="211" y2="789" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="794" x2="207" y2="794" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="206" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Trips</text>
    <!-- account -->
    <circle cx="304" cy="783" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="304" cy="795" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="304" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Account</text>
    <!-- more -->
    <circle cx="365" cy="783" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="789" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="795" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <text x="365" y="818" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
